item_number.description: Sequential line number or position identifier for the item within the purchase order, copied exactly as written including leading zeros.
item_number.title: Item Number

article_code.description: Customer article or product code for the ordered item, copied exactly as written preserving all characters and leading zeros.
article_code.title: Article Code

dimensions.description: Full dimension string for the ordered material, including units if present in the cell or appended from the header.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

material_grade.description: Alloy or material grade designation, copied exactly as written preserving formatting and case.
material_grade.title: Material Grade

quantity.description: Ordered quantity captured as text including the unit of measure when present or appended from the header.
quantity.title: Quantity

product_form.description: Physical form of the ordered material, mapped to the closest allowed value.
product_form.title: Product Form

standard_designation.description: Material or product standard designation found in the line item.
standard_designation.title: Standard Designation

cut_length.description: Specific cut length requested by the customer, if different from the standard mill length.
cut_length.title: Cut Length

temper_or_condition.description: Material temper, heat treatment, or delivery condition for the line item.
temper_or_condition.title: Temper Or Condition

hardness_hv.description: Required hardness in Vickers units, extracting only the numeric value.
hardness_hv.title: Hardness Hv

min_bend_radius.description: Minimum bend radius requirement, extracting only the numeric value.
min_bend_radius.title: Min Bend Radius

delivery_length_note.description: Free-text note about delivery length, cut tolerance, straightness, or packaging length constraints.
delivery_length_note.title: Delivery Length Note

applicable_standard.description: Additional standard or specification reference relevant to the line item beyond standard_designation.
applicable_standard.title: Applicable Standard

special_flags.description: Special instructions, quality requirements, customer-specific notes, or flags associated with the line item; concatenate multiple notes as a comma-separated string.
special_flags.title: Special Flags

description: Extraction model for PurchaseOrderERPRecord with repeated line_items

purchase_order_number.description: The customer's own purchase order reference number, copied exactly as it appears.
purchase_order_number.title: Purchase Order Number

delivery_date.description: The requested delivery date stated on the purchase order; output in DD/MM/YYYY.
delivery_date.title: Delivery Date

delivery_address.description: The full delivery address block as a single string.
delivery_address.title: Delivery Address

vendor_number.description: The identifier the customer uses internally to refer to the supplier/vendor, copied exactly as written.
vendor_number.title: Vendor Number

line_items.description: Repeated line item records from the purchase order item table.
line_items.title: Line Items
